question: Where can I get a list of data centers in operation in France, with location, operator and capacity (IT power in MW or floor area)?

answer.summary: No public national registry lists operating data centers in France. EU EED Art. 12 and French L. 236-1 / SDES (471 sites) / ARCEP publish aggregates only. Officially, Institut Paris Région's open GIS API covers 149 active Île-de-France sites with coordinates, operator, grid-MW class, and IT/building m², while EDF publishes 2 corporate sites on data.gouv.fr. Nationwide, DCmag (307 neutral sites), uMap/OSM (354 sites), and PeeringDB offer open locations and operators with partial or no capacity, alongside gated/paid directories (Baxtel 243 sites, GuideDC login DB, and blocked Data Center Map).
main_caveats: EU EED 2023/1791 Art. 12(3) and ecologie.gouv.fr restrict the European Data Centre Database to aggregated statistics; SDES's 471-DC inventory and ARCEP's ~160-DC survey publish aggregates only.

Institut Paris Région's official FeatureServer covers only Île-de-France (149 active out of 209 total; ~1/3 of French sites), and its 'puiss_mw_classe' field measures electrical connection capacity bins rather than IT load.

DRIEAT Île-de-France's data.gouv.fr mirror (6a1f7068092c5d59f2777f04) has broken Atom ('Accès non autorisé') and WFS endpoints; Institut Paris Région's geoweb.iau-idf.fr FeatureServer is the working official feed.

Nationwide non-official maps (DCmag 307 sites, PeeringDB) exclude private corporate/public sites such as EDF or banks, and DCmag exposes capacity only on individual copyrighted HTML pages rather than its bulk REST endpoint.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified across French ministries (ecologie.gouv.fr, DGE, SDES), regulator (ARCEP), regional portals (IPR, PACA/AURA/HdF), data.gouv.fr, EU EED legal texts, non-official APIs, and unstructured ICPE/EIA records.

where_published.name: Projets-Environnement (CGDD / Ministère de la Transition écologique)
where_published.what: National Opendatasoft v2.1 API holding 58 data-center EIA dossiers with impact-study PDFs (_FEI.pdf) and MRAe opinion PDFs (_AAE.pdf).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Query records with where=search(*,"data center") to list all 58 project dossiers and extract PDF links in dc_relation_expertise_avisae and dc_relation_expertise_etudeimpact.

example_document.what_it_gives: Avis délibéré MRAe APJIF-2023-041 (2023-08-09) for DATA 4 Marcoussis: 26,040 m² parcel extension with DC21 (3,970 m² / 15 MW IT), DC22 (3,970 m² / 15 MW IT), DC23 (8,260 m² / 30 MW IT), 100 MW total power feed.

where_published.name: Géorisques — API Installations Classées (ICPE)
where_published.what: Official national ICPE API returning SIRET, codeAIOT, etatActivite ('En exploitation avec titre'), exact WGS84/Lambert-93 coordinates, rubriques (3110/2910/2925), and PDF links to Arrêtés préfectoraux & inspection reports.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Query /api/v1/installations_classees?raisonSociale=OPERATOR (e.g., EQUINIX, DIGITAL REALTY) and inspect documentsHorsInspection / inspections PDFs.

example_document.what_it_gives: Arrêté préfectoral d'autorisation environnementale n°2019-194A (2021-01-11, scanned PDF) for INTERXION France 'MRS3' at Marseille 15e, rubriques 2910-A-2, 2925, 4802-2-a, 4734-2-c, 3110.

where_published.name: Missions régionales d'autorité environnementale (MRAe)
where_published.what: Searchable PDF environmental opinions on large data center construction/expansion filings nationwide.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Browse regional MRAe avis délibérés or access directly via Projets-Environnement dc_relation_expertise_avisae links.

example_document.what_it_gives: Avis délibéré APJIF-2025-095 (2025-11-19) for Equinix Hyperscale 2 (PA15) in Meudon (92): 22,178 m² footprint and 80 MW electrical capacity adjacent to operating PA13.

related_not_answering.name: SDES — La consommation d'électricité des data centers en 2024
related_not_answering.why: Publishes only aggregated electricity consumption across 471 metropolitan DCs > 1 GWh/yr by consumption band and département; internal OPERAT/EU inventory is confidential.

related_not_answering.name: ARCEP — Enquête annuelle pour un numérique soutenable (édition 2026)
related_not_answering.why: Lists 23 parent colocation operator names in Annexe 4 only and publishes national/regional aggregates (~600 MW IT in 2024) without a facility list.

related_not_answering.name: DRIEAT Île-de-France — Localisation des centres de données en Île-de-France (data.gouv.fr)
related_not_answering.why: Official Licence Ouverte 2.0 metadata entry whose Atom download returns 'Accès non autorisé' and WFS returns a MapServer access error; superseded by Institut Paris Région's active FeatureServer.

related_not_answering.name: Eurostat — Data centres' electricity consumption (isoc_env_ict_nrg)
related_not_answering.why: Reports France national annual aggregate consumption only (4,348.3 GWh in 2024), with no facility names, locations, or capacities.

related_not_answering.name: Les Datacenters financés par la Banque des Territoires (Caisse des Dépôts)
related_not_answering.why: Contains only 1 facility (ITH Center in Mamoudzou, Mayotte, 430 kW IT), not a national inventory of French data centers.

related_not_answering.name: Le Guide : Data Center — Carte des projets de data centers en France
related_not_answering.why: Public map covers 71 planned/under-construction projects in France only; its operational directory ('Database privée') is registration-gated and indexed separately in sources (rank 7).

open_questions: Whether DGEC or ARCEP will extend Annex VII / L. 236-1 public reporting beyond aggregate dashboards after 2026 EU reporting cycles remains open.
Full capacity fill rate across all 307 DCmag directory=20 HTML pages was sampled (11/307, ~40-45% disclosed) rather than bulk-scraped due to copyright terms.

history.note: No public national registry exists; EU EED and SDES inventories publish aggregates only. Official Île-de-France GIS API, EDF CSV, and open/gated non-official directories cover location, operator, and partial capacity.

in operation / operating (IPR 'statut' value; Géorisques ICPE uses 'En exploitation avec titre').

local_terms.term: surface des salles informatiques (surface IT) / surface de plancher (SDP)
